messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: RSubread Issues
parts:
Hi Angelo Pidroni,

A better place to ask this question would be on the Bioconductor Support site:

https://support.bioconductor.org/

You need to make sure your current working directory contains the FASTQ files. Use 'dir()' command to see if you can see your FASTQ files in your working directory.

Cheers,
Wei
